name: ScrollBar
description: Custom scrollbar overlay for scrollable containers. Vertical and horizontal variants. Track uses system border color; thumb uses white with Smooth shadow for lift effect.

root.note: Track container — full height (vertical) or full width (horizontal)

thumb.note: Draggable indicator positioned based on scroll position

usage.notes: Overlay the native scrollbar using CSS. Typically implemented via a scroll container library (e.g. overlayscrollbars). Don't use in short containers that don't scroll.

do: Make the thumb wide enough to be easily draggable (min 8px).
dont: Don't replace native scrollbars in accessibility-critical contexts without fallback.
